fullPassage: People in Western cultures are beginning to tell and act from a new earth story. This story is about all living things being connected. In The Hidden Life of Trees, author and botanist Peter Wohlleben explains how a forest is a single living entity, in which microbial, plant, and animal life communicate with each other to support the whole. When some trees are threatened by disease, nearby trees emit chemicals through their roots to support the infested trees. A vast underground network of roots and friendly fungi supports forest life. When plants need to be pollinated, they emit hormones and scents to attract pollinators. Every year, various plants and trees coordinate their blooming and fruiting, which benefits the entire system. Orchards will fruit heavily one year and lightly the next, as if they need a rest every other year. We are still learning how forest systems work.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

People in Western cultures are beginning to tell and act from a new earth story. This story is about all living things being connected.

(A) When some trees are threatened by disease, nearby trees emit chemicals through their roots to support the infested trees. A vast underground network of roots and friendly fungi supports forest life.
(B) In The Hidden Life of Trees, author and botanist Peter Wohlleben explains how a forest is a single living entity, in which microbial, plant, and animal life communicate with each other to support the whole.
(C) When plants need to be pollinated, they emit hormones and scents to attract pollinators. Every year, various plants and trees coordinate their blooming and fruiting, which benefits the entire system.

det.korean: 도입 → (B) 책 소개 → (A) 질병 시 화학물질 방출 → (C) 수분 및 개화 조율
det.analysis:
✅ (B)-(A)-(C): 도입(연결된 생명) → 책 소개(숲=하나의 생명체) → 질병 시 지원 → 수분과 개화
❌ (A)-(B)-(C): 질병 대응이 책 소개보다 먼저 나올 수 없음
❌ (B)-(C)-(A): 수분이 질병 대응보다 먼저 오면 흐름 부자연스러움
❌ (C)-(A)-(B): 수분이 먼저 나오고 책 소개가 마지막이면 비논리적
det.tip: 도입 → 책 소개 → 구체적 예시 순서

questions.stem:

(B) When some trees are threatened by disease, nearby trees emit chemicals through their roots to support the infested trees. A vast underground network of roots and friendly fungi supports forest life. When plants need to be pollinated, they emit hormones and scents to attract pollinators.
(C) This story is about all living things being connected. In The Hidden Life of Trees, author and botanist Peter Wohlleben explains how a forest is a single living entity, in which microbial, plant, and animal life communicate with each other to support the whole.

det.korean: 도입 → (C) 연결성 + 책 소개 → (B) 질병/수분 예시 → (A) 개화 조율 + 마무리
det.analysis:
✅ (C)-(B)-(A): 도입 → 연결성 설명 + 책 → 질병/수분 구체 예시 → 조율/마무리

❌ (B)-(A)-(C): 구체 예시가 주제 설명보다 먼저
❌ (C)-(A)-(B): 마무리가 중간에 위치
det.tip: 주제 제시 → 구체 사례 → 결론 순서
